
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/timothy020/p/19076956" title="发布于 2025-09-06 16:28">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Mac上安装Harbor并配置</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p><a href="https://github.com/goharbor/harbor/releases" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">官方的离线安装包</a>是 AMD64 版本的，不支持 M 系芯片的 Mac，会出现如下报错，所以要找<a href="https://github.com/wise2c-devops/build-harbor-aarch64/releases" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">社区编译的 ARM 版本</a>。</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">Prepare base dir is set to /Users/iven/Downloads/harbor
WARNING: The requested image's platform (linux/amd 64) does not match the detected host platform (linux/arm 64/v 8) and no specific platform was requested
</code></pre>
<h2 id="所需环境">所需环境</h2>
<ul>
<li>Docker Desktop</li>
<li>Docker-compose</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="下载安装包">下载安装包</h2>
<pre><code class="language-shell">wget https://github.com/wise2c-devops/build-harbor-aarch64/releases/download/v2.10.2/harbor-offline-installer-aarch64-v2.10.2.tgz
</code></pre>
<h2 id="更改配置文件">更改配置文件</h2>
<pre><code class="language-shell"># 解压
tar xvf harbor-offline-installer-aarch64-v2.10.2.tgz
# 进入harbor目录
cd harbor
# 重命名yml配置文件
mv harbor.yml.tmpl harbor.yml
# 修改配置文件
vim harbor.yml
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://02a6953.webp.li/2025/09/20250906125018.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://02a6953.webp.li/2025/09/20250906111848.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://02a6953.webp.li/2025/09/20250906134113.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>在 Docker Desktop 中输入快捷键 <code>cmd .</code> 进入偏好设置：<br>
<img src="https://02a6953.webp.li/2025/09/20250906112119.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="安装">安装</h2>
<pre><code class="language-shell">./install.sh
</code></pre>
<p>最终会启动 10 个容器<br>
<img src="https://02a6953.webp.li/2025/09/20250906134237.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="启动和停止">启动和停止</h2>
<pre><code class="language-shell"># 在harbor目录下操作
# 停止(加上-v参数会连带删除数据卷)
docker-compose stop
# 删除容器(加上-v参数会连带删除数据卷)
docker-compose down -v
# 后台启动
docker-compose up -d
# 重新构建并启动
docker-compose up --build -d
</code></pre>
<h2 id="访问">访问</h2>
<p>浏览器进入: http://&lt;设置的hostname&gt;:80</p>
<p><img src="https://02a6953.webp.li/2025/09/20250906112740.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="修改-docker-配置">修改 Docker 配置</h2>
<p>Linux 虚拟机中可以这么配置：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell"># 由于docker默认不允许使用非https方式推送镜像,所以在需要pull镜像的服务器配置访问地址
vim /etc/docker/daemon.json
#添加如下内容(客户端访问的网址)：
    "registry-mirrors":[
            "https://njrds9qc.mirror.aliyuncs.com"
         ],
    "insecure-registries" :[
           "192.168.31.48:80"
    ]
​
# 重启docker
systemctl restart docker
# 重启harbor容器，要在harbor目录下操作
docker-compose stop
docker-compose up -d
</code></pre>
<p>Mac 上直接在 Docker Desktop 配置：<br>
<img src="https://02a6953.webp.li/2025/09/20250906115021.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="推送镜像以官方-nginx-镜像为例">推送镜像（以官方 nginx 镜像为例）</h2>
<ol>
<li>准备工作：登陆 harbor，打标签</li>
</ol>
<pre><code class="language-shell"># docker登陆harbor
docker login 192.168.31.48:80 -u admin
# 给nginx镜像打一个标签
# 格式： docker tag 镜像名:版本 your-ip:端口/项目名称/新的镜像名:版本
docker tag nginx:latest 192.168.31.48:80/library/nginx:latest
</code></pre>
<p>结果如下：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">➜ harbor docker images
REPOSITORY                       TAG       IMAGE ID       CREATED       SIZE
192.168.31.48:80/library/nginx   latest    47ef8710c9f5   3 weeks ago   198MB
nginx                            latest    47ef8710c9f5   3 weeks ago   198MB
</code></pre>
<ol start="2">
<li>开始推送</li>
</ol>
<pre><code class="language-shell">➜ harbor docker push 192.168.31.48:80/library/nginx:latest
The push refers to repository [192.168.31.48:80/library/nginx]
be61b0da9648: Pushed
58d58d2ade95: Pushed
beb3bb225b88: Pushed
bdc4a6d15284: Pushed
4b950e3c58cf: Pushed
e0ed4995377a: Pushed
f0f023a63482: Pushed
latest: digest: sha256:148cb3109165d936620429e68a78b0880009148826cc0900c5de1d04f5694061 size: 1778
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://02a6953.webp.li/2025/09/20250906133928.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
